text:
paul: Quick heads-up — router will add route-affinity header rewrite for the embeddings path. Need API + runtime pin. Window Mon 01:00-01:20 UTC. Low risk but touches cache keys.
mina: What's the exact change? paste the snippet so QA can validate.
paul: Snippet below. Router rule rewrites X-Affinity -> X-Affinity-Emb for /embeds/* and runtime gets a flag to honor the new header. Router -> 3.7.0, runtime flag -> --embed-affinity=enable.
--- router.rules ---
- path: /embeds/*
  rewrite_headers:
    - from: X-Affinity
      to: X-Affinity-Emb
--- end ---
zara: Prefer 3-step canary: 1% -> 10% -> 100% with manual holds at each checkpoint.
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: router, version: "3.7.0", window: "2026-07-12T01:00:00Z/2026-07-12T01:20:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: pin created: {service: api, version: "1.17.2", window: "2026-07-12T01:00:00Z/2026-07-12T01:20:00Z"} :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: Quiet-window scheduled at 00:50 UTC. Watch rule: router/5xx > 3/min OR embed/hit-rate drop > 10% -> notify #eng-oncall and this thread.
mina: Rollback command if things go sideways?
paul: Run: `deployctl traffic swap --service router --from 3.7.0 --to 3.6.9 --instant`
zara: And runtime revert: `deployctl feature unset --service runtime --flag embed-affinity`
qa-bot: Preflight queued: embed-route-smoke, api-embed-compat, runtime-cache-smoke.
deploy-bot: Canary start: router 1% -> 3.7.0; runtime flag staged at 1% canary.
qa-bot: Smoke: embed lookup p95 increased ~25ms on canary nodes, hit-rate initially looks stable.
sre-bot: Alert: embed/hit-rate fell 12% on a small shard -> paging eng-oncall.
paul: Pausing rollout. Investigating cache churn and evictions.
mina: I see cache evictions on runtime-canary-2 correlating with the new header key variants.
zara: Given cache churn and hit-rate dip, let's roll router back and revert flag, then run a warm-prefetch offline before retry.
deploy-bot: traffic swap executed: router 3.7.0 -> 3.6.9 by mina at 01:06 UTC.
deploy-bot: runtime feature unset: embed-affinity removed.
sre-bot: Alerts cleared. embed hit-rate returned to baseline. KV eviction rate normalized.
paul: Summary: attempted affinity header rewrite, pinned services, 1% canary revealed cache key churn and hit-rate dip; rolled back router and reverted runtime flag. Follow-up: add warm-prefetch job and increase canary cache allocation. Filing EMBED-2043.
zara: I'll update release notes with the aborted rollout and schedule a re-run after warm-prefetch is in place. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
